acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc:
A family sits down to discuss one thing. But then the true purpose of the meeting emerges. (9 ½ minutes)
The meeting in this story was recorded by Lexie Harrison-Cripps, who's working on a film project about Bryan LeBaron's activism work.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: For one kibbutz-dwelling family in Israel, the decision of where to land after the October 7th attacks goes back and forth… and back… and forth.
acts.title: A Slow Decision Process That’s Mostly But Maybe Not Completely Over

acts.desc: Ira learns about — and has a few thoughts on — one coach’s striking technique to keep the morale of his high school football team on the up, week after week. (3 ½ minutes)
acts.label: Act 2
acts.title: One More Week with Coach McGuire

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: An excerpt from “Belles Lettres," a short story by Nafissa Thompson-Spires from her book Heads of the Colored People, performed by actors Erika Alexander and Eisa Davis with a cameo from our colleague Alvin Melathe.
acts.credits: By Nafissa Thompson-Spires; Produced by Bim Adewunmi
